append.detail: Closed 2026-10-20. A steward of a Journey's Space invites another Space by address from /spaces/<slug>/journeys; the invited Space's stewards accept or decline there; either side can end it. Auto-accepts when the caller stewards both Spaces. Writes ride cohost-actions.ts, which is the authority because the table is service role only. No migration. The invited Space sees a pending invite on its own Journeys page; no notification is sent.
